nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a$, $b$ and $m$ write $F_m(a, b) = a^{b^m} + 1$. Let $a, b, D \ge 2$ and $n$ be natural numbers such that $D$ divides $F_n(a, b)$. If $b$ is odd, then $D$ divides $F_{n+k}(a, b)$ for every $k \ge 1$. If $b$ is even and $D \ge 3$, then $D$ does not divide $F_{n+k}(a, b)$ for any $k \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Divisibility of later generalized Fermat numbers

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a$, $b$ and $k$ write $F_k(a, b) = a^{b^k} + 1$, and let $a, b \ge 2$ and $m$, $n$ be natural numbers. If $n < m$ and $a$ and $b$ are both even, then $\gcd(F_m(a, b), F_n(a, b)) = 1$. If $n < m$, $a$ is odd and $b$ is even, then $\gcd(F_m(a, b), F_n(a, b)) = 2$. If $n \le m$ and $b$ is odd, then $\gcd(F_m(a, b), F_n(a, b)) = F_n(a, b)$.
nodes.title: Greatest common divisors of generalized Fermat numbers

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a$, $b$ and $k$ write $F_k(a, b) = a^{b^k} + 1$. Let $a, b \ge 2$, let $p$ be a prime, and let $n_0$ be the least natural number with $p^2 \mid F_{n_0}(a, b)$. Say that the sequence $(F_k(a, b))_k$ is periodic modulo $p^2$ from index $m$ if there is a $T > 0$ with $F_{m+k+T}(a, b) \equiv F_{m+k}(a, b) \pmod{p^2}$ for every $k \ge 0$. If $b$ is odd, then $n_0$ is the least index from which the…
nodes.title: Start of the period of generalized Fermat numbers modulo the square of a prime

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a$, $b$ and $n$ write $F_n(a, b) = a^{b^n} + 1$, and let $\Omega(N)$ be the number of prime factors of $N$ counted with multiplicity. If $a, b \ge 2$ and $b$ is odd, then $\Omega(F_n(a, b)) \le \Omega(F_m(a, b))$ for all natural numbers $n \le m$.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the number of prime factors of generalized Fermat numbers

nodes.summary: Let $a, b, m \ge 2$ and $n \ge 1$ be natural numbers with $a^{b^n} \not\equiv 1 \pmod m$. Then $a^{b^t} \not\equiv 1 \pmod m$ for every natural number $t < n$.
nodes.title: Smaller iterated powers are not congruent to one

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and $a$ a natural number not divisible by $p$. Then $a^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{p^2}$, that is, $p$ is a Wieferich prime to base $a$, if and only if the multiplicative order of $a$ modulo $p^2$ equals the multiplicative order of $a$ modulo $p$.
nodes.title: Wieferich primes to base $a$ via multiplicative orders

nodes.summary: Let $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$ be the $n$-th Fermat number. For every natural number $n$ and every odd prime $p$, $p^2$ divides $F_n$ if and only if $p$ is a Wieferich prime (to base $2$) and the multiplicative order of $2$ modulo $p$ is $2^{n+1}$.
nodes.title: Squared prime factors of Fermat numbers via Wieferich primes and orders

nodes.summary: Let $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$ be the $n$-th Fermat number, and let $p$ be a prime dividing $F_n$. Then $p^2$ divides $F_n$ if and only if $2^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{p^2}$.
nodes.title: Squared prime factors of Fermat numbers

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a$, $b$ and $n$ write $F_n(a, b) = a^{b^n} + 1$. Let $a, b \ge 2$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $p$ be an odd prime coprime to $ab$, and write $\operatorname{ord}_p(a)$ for the multiplicative order of $a$ modulo $p$. If $p^2$ divides $F_n(a, b)$, then $a^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{p^2}$ (that is, $p$ is a Wieferich prime to base $a$) and $\operatorname{ord}_p(a)$ divides $2b^n$. Conversely, if…
nodes.title: Squared prime factors of generalized Fermat numbers

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $a$ be a natural number not divisible by $p$, and let $n$ be a natural number. Then $p^2$ divides $a^{2^n} + 1$ if and only if $a^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{p^2}$ (that is, $p$ is a Wieferich prime to base $a$) and the multiplicative order of $a$ modulo $p$ is $2^{n+1}$.
nodes.title: Squared prime factors of $a^{2^n} + 1$

nodes.summary: Let $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$ be the $n$-th Fermat number. For every $n \ge 2$ and every odd prime $p$ dividing $F_n$, we have $2^{(p-1)/2} \equiv 1 \pmod{F_n}$. This result is due to Warren and Bray (1967).
nodes.title: Warren–Bray congruence for prime divisors of Fermat numbers
